guides.title: Locate column reads and writes
guides.terms: column field read write written reads writes functions repositories lineage usage impact

stages.goal: Resolve the exact cached database/table/column; keep ambiguity explicit
Inspect classified column accesses, caller chains, revisions and incomplete coverage
Read exact function/source evidence, including dynamic SQL and generated-code gaps

boundaries: A text hit is not proof of read/write access. Unknown dynamic SQL, missing revisions or bounded traversal prevent an exhaustive claim.

guides.title: Recreate a cross-system bug
guides.terms: recreate reproduce reproduction bug related entities databases postgres pg tables elasticsearch es kafka messages streams capture fixture state tenant

stages.goal: Inventory every known read and action from the selected service/passport
Bind scoped relational tuples and explicit PG/ES/Kafka obligations, schemas and windows
Capture read-only source state and inspect completeness, precision, hashes and consistency
Export resources, replay into owned isolated dependencies and independently observe effects

boundaries: Separate per-source snapshots do not establish a distributed atomic snapshot or exactly-once delivery.
Truncated windows, missing schemas/codecs or unbound reads must remain gaps.

guides.title: Prove a refactor preserves behavior
guides.terms: refactor method function results fills fields enrichment compare differential old new baseline same locally dev environment

stages.goal: Resolve function and library versions, enrichment precedence and affected callers
Capture source function/schema versions and representative null/error/precision inputs
Compare old/new exact values, ordering, errors and independently observed effects using reviewed runners

boundaries: Captured-dev local equivalence and observations of a deployed dev process are separate verdicts.
Normalization must be explicit; it must not erase business differences.

guides.title: Run a test against an explicit target
guides.terms: run execute test tests dev environment staging target remote deployment

stages.goal: Inspect workspace language/build capability and target placement, dependencies and allowed effects
Run the selected supported test on the exact reviewed target and poll its job
Check executed assertions, cleanup and target revision; retain red/green evidence

boundaries: env=dev alone selects source context; it does not select a remote runner or a deployed application.
No tests, skipped-only runs, unsupported targets or cleanup failures cannot prove success.

guides.title: Investigate an unexplained service symptom
guides.terms: bug exception error incident production failing wrong timeout intermittent service reservation invoice reconciliation

stages.goal: Identify deployment revision, health, configuration and relevant logs before diagnosing
Follow the entrypoint through service/library code and scoped data reads
Capture a minimal failing state and run an independent regression

boundaries: Symptom keyword matches route investigation; they do not identify the cause.

guides.title: Implement a sensitive regression test
guides.terms: implement write create add unit integration contract regression tests test mocks fixture complexity

stages.goal: Resolve actual application entrypoints, dependencies and supported build capability
Create valid edge objects or replay related state without inventing missing inputs
Execute the application, show failure before the fix and pass after; reject a relevant defect

boundaries: An external grader pass cannot substitute for supported tool execution.

guides.title: Turn UI traffic into a reusable API check
guides.terms: browser playwright ui network request response api routes discover client json pretty scripts collections reuse save

stages.goal: Inspect the UI and capture bounded browser network evidence with secrets removed
Inspect attributed routes and request/response JSON in the interactive client
Replay only allowlisted intended requests and save a parameterized script/collection

boundaries: Captured credentials remain placeholders. Replaying a mutation requires the user's intended action scope.

guides.title: Update understandable architecture knowledge
guides.terms: knowledge confluence rag graph documentation architecture semantic mirror update migration source

stages.goal: Inspect source provenance, stale records and exact citations
Refresh a selected source, then inspect typed edges and coverage

boundaries: Knowledge projections retain source identity; a successful mirror does not prove runtime dependencies.
